The inbuilt stylus adds a premium look and feel to the smartphone. It's fun navigating and using the smartphone with the stylus. However I found two issues which I would like to share:
1. The stylus gets stuck in its slot sometimes and then you have to insert your nails to make it 'click' again in order to remove it.
2. After applying a protective glass, the smoothness and touch response of the stylus in decreases in some areas of the screen.
